top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) rests on the clearest physical principle on the slate: a small molecule induces a ternary complex with an E3 ligase and drives catalytic, event-driven removal of the target, which is quantitatively measurable and independently reproduced. It opens previously undruggable proteins to design, and the cereblon finding ties the strand to thalidomide-class medicines already in patients, so one honest citation on induced proximity covers both. Phase separation (P004) is a strong physical-chemical principle but its cellular function is still contested; P003 is mature but a narrower two-name lineage; P002 is clean but a method following the 2010 coupling prize.
